title: Preprocessing, Features, and Trustworthy Pipelines
audience: Basic science researchers new to AI
objectives: Apply normalization and augmentation, and say what a transform fabricates.
Match a denoising filter to the artifact it assumes.
Compare Sobel, Canny, and Otsu on a controlled image and explain how each fails.
Judge whether an imaging pipeline is consistent enough to publish from.

sections.name: Working image
sections.purpose: Pick one image and keep it across activities 1-3.
sections.how_to_use: A selectbox for the bundled brightfield or fluorescence samples, or an upload.

sections.name: Activity selector
sections.purpose: Four activities behind one segmented control.
sections.how_to_use: Click a chip to switch activity. All four share the working-image selectbox above them.

sections.name: Activity 1 - Normalization & Augmentation
sections.purpose: Teach a model the shape of a structure, not its position.
sections.how_to_use: Set the normalization factor and rotation angle, and tick the horizontal/vertical flip checkboxes. Note that rotation uses mode='wrap', so it fabricates the corners.

sections.name: Activity 2 - Artifacts & Denoising
sections.purpose: Match the fix to the fault.
sections.how_to_use: Motion blur first (length and angle) -- irreversible, so the right response is to re-acquire. Then salt-and-pepper noise: set the amount, choose Median or Gaussian, and compare the mean-absolute-error metric. Median wins because an outlier is never the median.

sections.name: Activity 3 - Feature Extraction
sections.purpose: Compare edge and threshold methods where the right answer is known.
sections.how_to_use: Two parts: 3.1 directional and Sobel gradients across five panels; 3.2 a synthetic bright rectangle with controllable noise, compared four ways (input, Sobel, Canny, Otsu) with a 'Reveal logic' checkbox under each panel. Because the true boundary is a perfect square, every departure is the method's error.

sections.name: Activity 4 - Is the Pipeline Trustworthy?
sections.purpose: Decide whether the pipeline is consistent enough to act on.
sections.how_to_use: Choose the application, then work the six-gate consistency checklist. The score and verdict update as boxes are ticked; it opens at 0/6 by design. Three reflection prompts follow.

chatbot_guidance: The right filter is the one whose assumption matches the artifact: median for outliers, Gaussian for smooth additive noise, and nothing at all for motion blur -- reject and re-acquire.
The mean-absolute-error metric in tab 2 lets the learner measure the median-vs-Gaussian claim instead of taking it on faith.

Two experiments worth suggesting in tab 3: raise the noise to 100 and compare Sobel against Canny; then set the blur sigma to 0 and watch Otsu break, which shows the pre-blur was doing more work than the thresholding.
The tab 4 checklist opens at 0/6 by design.
